header: FORMER NAMES of a department: when a question uses one, I show the CURRENT name first (step 59a). My rule (26 Oct 2026): CHRD was first the Training Department, later CHRD, and is now the Centre for L & D (CL&D). Keep the previous names as aliases: people still say Training Department or CHRD. If anyone searches with them, print the current name before the answer, to acknowledge it. This file is pure (no server code): the query modal calls it with the question that was searched, so the notice stands above ANY kind of answer (people, circulars, announcements ...), even while the answer is loading. The department itself is found by the alias group of departmentAliases.ts (the same words, so the notice and the answer cannot disagree); this file only says what the old words are and what the new name is. To add another renamed department, add one entry to RENAMED.

doc: The current name, as I show it.

members.name: history

members.name: former
doc: The OLD names a question may use. The current name does not need a notice, so it is not listed here.

symbols.name: RENAMED
symbols.sig: const RENAMED: Renamed[] = [ { current: "Centre for L & D (CL&D)", history: ["Training Department", "CHRD", "Centre for L & D (CL&D)"], …

symbols.name: OTHER_PLANT
doc: Another plant's CHRD (Bhilai, Bokaro, Rourkela ...) or the corporate one is NOT the Durgapur department that was renamed. So I show no notice then, and the department-name lookups (departmentAliases.ts, sailDepartments.ts) do not take it for the CL&D rows either.

members.name: used
doc: The old name the question used, in the form I quote it ("CHRD").

members.name: sentence
doc: The sentence I show first: “CHRD” is now called Centre for L & D (CL&D).

members.name: history
doc: The names in order, for the small line under the sentence.

symbols.name: formerNameNotice
symbols.sig: export function formerNameNotice(question: string): FormerNameNotice | null
doc: Returns the notice for a question that uses a former name, or null. I let the first former name in the text win.

behaviours: the confirmed full form of CHRD shows the notice, quoted as typed (Centre or Center)
'Centre for HRD' is not used at the plant: no notice
the full form of the CURRENT name (Learning and Development, confirmed by the HOD) is not a former name: no notice
the small line under it is the history, oldest first: Training Department → CHRD → Centre for L & D (CL&D)
when a question has both, the one written FIRST is quoted
a missing question gives nothing, never an error
the table has the department once, with its current name and a history that ends with it
the current name is NOT among the former names (it would warn about itself)
